decision: 5 Second time penalty. (1 penalty point awarded, 3 for the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 21 October 2018 Time 14:47 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 left the track in turn1 and retained his position and therefore gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence noticing that entering turn 1 car 55 was slightly in front of car 8, car 55 left the track whilst exiting turn1 therefore retaining the position. The Stewards concluded that car 55 left the track and gained a lasting advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 44 2018 United States Grand Prix Offence Car 55 Leaving Track And Gaining An Advantage
